RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday,  the November 29, 2006/Agrahayana 8, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs;
Labour and Employment; Rural Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 20
Closure of industries in Andhra
Pradesh
*101. SHRI NANDI YELLAIAH: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the public sector and
private sector industries closed down in
Andhra Pradesh during the last three years;
(b) whether Government have
conducted any study to assess the
genuinity of their closure;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the names of the sick industries in
the State for revival of which Government
are making efforts, giving the details of such
efforts?
Deportation of Bangladeshi nationals
from NCR
*102. SHRI VARINDER SINGH
BAJWA: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) the State-wise number of
Bangladeshis detected so far during 2006
who are living illegally in Delhi and in the
surrounding areas in the National Capital
Region; and
(b) the number of Bangladeshis living
illegally in the above areas, identified so
far, during the last three years, till
31st October, 2006, and those deported?
Increase in terrorism, naxalism and
militancy in States
†*103. SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
DR. PRABHA THAKUR:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the incidents of terrorism,
naxalism and militancy are still continuing
in some States; and
(b) to what extent Government have
achieved success in checking the increasing
incidents of terrorism in States, giving the
State-wise details thereof?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

33
SHG Programme for self-reliance and
income generation in rural areas
†*104. SHRI MANGANI LAL
MANDAL: Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that targets under
Self Help Groups Programme for economic
self-reliance and income generation in rural
areas are not fixed for commercial banks
and Regional Rural Banks, barring
NABARD;
(b) whether it is also a fact that in the
process of fixing the size of credit scheme,
the target of Self Help Groups is not fixed
in the P.L.P. made by NABARD; and
(c) if so, Government's view in this
regard, State-wise situation and
achievement, alongwith details thereof?
Development of Southern Naval
Command
*105. SHRI THENNALA G.
BALAKRISHNA PILLAI: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any
proposal for development of Southern
Naval Command, Kochi; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
ARWSP in Kerala
*106. SHRI A. VIJAYARAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether there are many Accelerated
Rural Water Supply Programmes (ARWSP)
in Kerala, undertaken with the assistance
of Central Government;
(b) if so, the details of such schemes as
on date, category-wise;
(c) the total revised estimates for the
above schemes and the total Central
assistance, as on date, category-wise;
(d) whether the competent authority of
Kerala sought higher allocations during
August, 2006, for completion of the
schemes within three years;
(e) if so, the details of action taken, if
any; and
(f) if not, the reasons therefor?
States not following priorities fixed by
Government regarding NREGS
*107. DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that only a few
States, where the National Rural
Employment Guarantee Scheme (NREGS)
is being implemented, have followed the
priorities fixed by the Central Government;
(b) if so, the details thereof, State-wise;
and
(c) the corrective measures taken by
Government to see that the priorities fixed
by the Central Government are followed
by the State Governments?
Ban on employing children below age
of 14 years
*108. SHRIMATI MOHSINA
KIDWAI:
SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a ban has
been imposed recently on employing
children below the age of 14 years in dhabas,
restaurants, homes etc.;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

34
(b) if so, the details thereof, including
the machinery established to implement the
ban;
(c) a broad estimate of the number of
children who are employed as labour and
are likely to be affected by the ban; and
(d) the details of the comprehensive
plan drawn up, if any, to rehabilitate the
children who would be rendered jobless?
Fracas by military personnel in trains
†*109. SHRI SHAHID SIDDIQUI:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
there has been an increase in the incidents
of military personnel coming face to face
quarrelling with common passengers in
trains;
(b) the number of such incidents which
came to the notice of Government during
the last three years;
(c) the reasons for increase in such
incidents; and
(d) the steps being taken to prevent
such incidents?
Influx of Nepalese Muslims into
Uttaranchal
†*110. SHRI UDAY PRATAP
SINGH: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn towards influx of Nepalese
nationals, belonging to the Muslim
community, from bordering areas of Nepal
to Pithoragarh and other districts of
Uttaranchal;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) the total number of such Nepalese
Muslim families identified so far; and
(d) the steps being taken by
Government to check the influx?
Induction of Akash, Nag and Trishul
missiles
*111. SHRI O.T. LEPCHA:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of cost escalation and
delays in development of Akash, Nag and
Trishul missiles;
(b) how many successful tests of these
missiles have been conducted so far, giving
the year-wise details for each missile;
(c) why these systems have not been
inducted into the armed forces, despite
many successful tests;
(d) by when these systems are likely to
be inducted; and
(e) what alternative measures have been
taken to discount adverse impact on the
combat preparedness of defence forces, due
to delay in induction of these missile
systems?
Adverse effect of cheap imports
†*112. SHRI JAI PARKASH
AGGARWAL: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Indian industry is
experiencing an adverse effect, following
sale at cheaper rates of the goods imported
from China and other countries;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government have taken or
contemplate to take any action to impose
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

35
ban on goods imported from other
countries;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Air power to combat Maoists menace
*113. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Centre propose to provide
air power to combat Maoists menace in
the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) what is the action plan of the Centre
to extend air power to Orissa, to combat
this menace;
(d) whether, barring a few segments,
the situation in the country is under control;
and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Bomb blasts in Sarojini Nagar,
Delhi
†*114. SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) the number of persons killed and
injured, respectively, in the serial bomb
blasts in Sarojini Nagar area of Delhi, last
year;
(b) the amount of compensation paid
by Government for those killed and to those
injured;
(c) whether Government have fully
borne the expenses incurred on the
treatment of the injured and also issued
instructions to treat the period of leave
taken during this treatment, as extra ordinary
leave; and
(d) if not, what are the reasons therefor?
Assistance for modernisation of
security system in Goa
*115. SHRI SHANT ARAM
LAXMAN NAIK: Will the Minister of
HOME AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether in view of the increasing
number of foreign tourists coming to Goa
and also in view of the recent threat
perceptions assessed in the State, the Goa
Police have chalked out any plan for
modernisation of State level security
system, including at various Police Stations
in the State;
(b) whether Government have
sanctioned financial, technical and other
type of assistance to the State Government
in this regard; and
(c) if so, the details of various types of
assistance given or proposed to be given to
the State Government?
New BPL survey
*116. SHRIMATI BRINDA KARAT:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are going to
have a new BPL survey in the Year-2007;
(b) if so, whether the schedule for the
survey has been prepared; and
(c) if not, which schedule will be used,
giving the details thereof?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

36
Loss to diamond exports
*117. SHRI MAHENDRA MOHAN:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) what has been the extent of loss to
diamond export, during the last eight
months;
(b) besides the recent floods in Surat,
what are the other factors contributing to
the loss in the export of diamonds; and
(c) what steps are being undertaken by
Government to arrest the losses, and to
boost the diamond industry?
Reduction in transaction costs for
exports
*118. SHRI RAJEEV SHUKLA: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Indian
exporters have to incur huge transaction
costs to transport their products in foreign
markets, compared to exporters from other
countries;
(b) if so, whether Government have
taken any steps to reduce the transaction
costs and to simplify the procedures, in
order to make our exporters more
competitive;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Trade relations with China, USA and
Russia
†*119. SHRI DWIJENDRA NATH
SHARMAH: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are taking any
steps to boost trade relations between India-
China, India-USA and India-Russia;
(b) if so, for which sectors of trade
Government have chalked out a strategy;
and
(c) if not, what are the reasons therefor?
Technological overhaul of anti-terror
machinery
*120. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that
Administrative Reforms Commission
(ARC) has recommended to Government a
total technological overhaul of the anti-
terror machinery, and streamlining of the
intelligence network, to make the campaign
against terrorists a big success;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) how Government are planning to
associate civil society in drive against such
activities?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday,  the November 29, 2006/Agrahayana 8, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs; Labour and
Employment; Rural Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 155
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Review of FTAs
709. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) to what extent the Free Trade
Agreements with various countries have
benefited the farmers of other countries;
(b) whether there is a proposal to review
the benefits of such agreements;
(c) if so, whether all such agreements
would be reviewed, freshly assessed and
audited to find out their benefits; and
(d) the steps proposed to review all those
agreements?
NSC caution regarding foreign
investment
†710. SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the National
Security Council has advised Government
to exercise care in granting approvals to
foreign capital investments for certain areas;
(b) if so, the details thereof and whether
the council has identified the countries from
which capital investments should be obtained
carefully; and
(c) if so, which are those countries?
Fall in price of spices
711. SHRI K. CHANDRAN PILLAI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is a
downward trend in the price of spices;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government have taken
measures to protect the interests of the
farmers against the price fluctuations; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Investments by Indian businessmen
abroad
†712. SHRI PYARELAL
KHANDELWAL: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Indian
businessmen/industrialists are investing

167
abroad, instead of investing in Indian
industries;
(b) whether Indian companies are
lagging far behind in the matter of
investments in Indian projects, in
comparison to other countries;
(c) if so, whether Government are aware
of this phenomenon; and
(d) if so, what are the details thereof and
what necessary steps are being taken by
Government in this regard?
Economic partnership agreement with
Japan
713. SHRI T.S. BAJWA: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to enter
into an economic partnership agreement
with Japan, on the lines of the agreements
signed with Mauritius and Singapore; and
(b) if so, by when the agreement would
be finalized and its likely benefits to the
country?
FDI in Andhra Pradesh
714. SHRI M.V. MYSURA REDDY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the State-wise details of Foreign
Direct Investment permitted by
Government, for industrialization in the
country, during the last three years;
(b) whether Government have
formulated any scheme to promote/permit
more Foreign Direct Investment in Andhra
Pradesh, in comparison to other States;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, what other steps are being
taken by Government to promote
industrialization in Andhra Pradesh?
FDI in India vis-a-vis China, Russia
and Brazil
715. MS. MABEL REBELLO: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) how does the present level of FDI in
the country compare with other countries
like China, Russia and Brazil;
(b) what are the reasons for the
difference; and
(c) what steps Government propose to
take to attract more FDI?
Export of tea, pepper and cardamom
716. SHRI TARINI KANTA ROY: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the details of development schemes
undertaken for increasing productivity and
for export of tea, pepper and cardamom;
(b) the quantum of processed food
products exported during the last three
years; and
(c) whether it is a fact that inroads of
processed food product in domestic market
have posed threat to Indian companies?
Import of agricultural products
717. SHRI THANGA TAMIL
SELVAN: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of major agricultural
products imported during the last three
years, with quantity;
(b) the reasons for their import;
(c) whether such imports affected the
local farmers/traders; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?

168
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Promotion of industries in
Uttrakhand
718. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) what steps have been taken by
Government to promote industries in
Uttrakhand;
(b) what have been the results of these
steps during the last two years and the
current year, so far; and
(c) what financial provisions have been
made by Government in this regard during
the same period?
Industries in industrially backward
districts of AP
719. SHRI NANDI YELLAIAH: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the proposals if any,
for setting up industrial units in the
industrially backward districts of
Shrikakulam and Mehboobnagar in Andhra
Pradesh; and
(b) if the answer to part (a) above be in
the negative, the reasons therefor?
Protection of domestic Vanaspathi
industry
720. SHRI NANDI YELLAIAH: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
Directorate of Vanaspathi has
recommended for fixation of duty free
import of Vanaspathi upto 50,000 Tons
per annum from Sri Lanka, as quantitative
import restriction, to protect the domestic
industry and oil seed farmers;
(b) if so, the reasons for not taking
immediate action in implementing this
recommendations in view of the fact that
the domestic Vanaspathi industry is on the
verge of complete closure, as 70% of the
Vanaspathi industries have already been
closed down;
(c) whether Government would
immediately issue necessary orders in this
regard; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Indination of South Asian countries to
invest in NE
721. SHRI KARNENDU BHATTA-
CHARJEE: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether South Asian countries,
including Malaysia, have shown their
inclination for investment in industries in the
North East, particularly in Assam;
(b) if so, whether any trade delegation
has visited Assam to explore areas of
industries/trade and if so, its outcome; and
(c) Government's response to accelerate
the process?
Decline in percentage of
manufacturing sector in exports
†722. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether participation of
manufacturing sector in the exports from the
country has been decreasing during last
three years;
(b) if so, what was its exports in the year
2003-04, 2004-05 and 2005-06; and
(c) what are the estimates of its
participation during the first six months of
the current year?

169
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Dumping of scrap metals into the
country
723. SHRI MANOHAR JOSHI: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the country is being made a
dumping ground for all kinds of scrap metals,
which are imported freely;
(b) if so, the details of various scrap
metal being imported and the names of
countries from where these are imported;
(c) whether Government would
reconsider and restrict such imports to the
minimum; and
(d) if so, the action taken in that regard?
SEZ by WIPRO in Nagpur
†724. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the officers
of WIPRO and some other companies have
visited Nagpur, to have Special Economic
Zone in that area;
(b) if so, whether the company has
applied to set up Special Economic Zone in
Nagpur;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) by when the Special Economic Zone
would be set up by that company?
Avoiding SEZs on agricultural land
725. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the SEZ
Board is not supposed to give clearance to
any SEZ proposal which includes Prime
Agricultural Land;
(b) if so, what is the specific definition
of Prime Agricultural Land;
(c) whether it is a fact that the
Visakhapatnam SEZ covers cashewnut and
coconut plantations;
(d) if so, the steps proposed to remove
all coconut and cashewnut plantations from
the Visakhapatnam SEZ; and
(e) the reasons for ignoring rules
regarding avoiding use of agricultural land?
Rapidity in granting clearance to SEZ
proposals
726. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to newsitem appearing in the
Financial Express dated the 4th November,
2006, captioned “Reports of more than 150
SEZ proposals referred by Board of
Approvals”;
(b) if so, what are the reasons for the
rapidity in clearance of all the SEZ approvals;
(c) whether it is a fact that the SEZ
Board has ignored numerous infirmities and
false statistics in most of the applications;
(d) if so, what steps would be taken to
review all the clearances given by the SEZ
Board;
(e) whether it is a fact that no public
hearings were held before giving such
clearances; and
(f) if so, the reasons for ignoring the
procedures?

170
Salt pans in Mumbai
727. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) what is the total area of salt pans in
Mumbai and who are their owners;
(b) how many persons are employed in
cultivating salt in these salt pans;
(c) whether the Ministry proposes to allot
the land of these salt pans for low cost
housing, for the resettlement of slum
dwellers; and
(d) if so, the details in this regard and
what are plans of the Ministry to resettle
the workers working on these salt pans?
Multi-product SEZ near
Visakhapatnam
728. SHRI V. HANUMANTHA RAO:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have allowed
a multi-product SEZ near Visakhapatnam;
(b) if so, the approval given for any SEZ
in or near Visakhapatnam;
(c) the area, category and type and
product-specific SEZ permitted at
Visakhapatnam;
(d) whether Government have allowed
prime agricultural land to be included in this
SEZ;
(e) if so, the details of the SEZ; and
(f) whether public hearings would be held
in Visakhapatnam on this SEZ?
SEZs in Goa
729. SHRI SHANTARAM LAXMAN
NAIK: Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Government of Goa has
proposed the establishment of Special
Economic Zones in the State;
(b) if so, the number of such Zones
proposed to be established;
(c) the details regarding the status of the
proposal to establish SEZs in that State;
(d) the total area identified/acquired for
the purpose and the location thereof; and
(e) the type of units proposed to be
established in these zones?
Virginia tobacco farmers in the
country
730. DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the total number of Virginia tobacco
farmers in the country;
(b) whether it is a fact that the farmers
have sought permission to expand their
Virginia Tobacco cultivation;
(c) if so, the reaction of Government in
this respect; and
(d) the steps taken to assist the Indian
Tobacco farmers?
Non-tariff barriers on Indian tobacco
by USA
731. DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the total quantity of exports of un-
manufactured tobacco exported to USA
during the last three years, year-wise;
(b) whether it is a fact that the USA has
imposed non-tariff barriers on Indian
Tobacco;
(c) if so, whether Government have
received representations from farmers in this
regard; and

171
(d) if so, the steps taken by Government
to raise this issue with the USA Government?
Wheat import by STC
732. SHRI AMAR SINGH: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) what is the total quantity of wheat
imported by STC during the last three
months, and how much expenditure, per ton,
was incurred thereon; and
(b) whether it is a fact that a shipment
of 50,000 tonnes of wheat, imported from
Russia in September, 2006, was rejected by
STC and if so, the details thereof and
whether the wheat has since been returned
to Russia, and if not, the reasons therefor?
India's export trade viz-a-viz Asian
countries
733. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Reserve Bank of India
has made a comparative study of India's
export potential viz-a-viz neighbouring
Asian countries like China;
(b) if so, what is the share of India in
export trade viz-a-viz neighbouring Asian
countries like China; and
(c) what are the prospects for capturing
increased share in merchandise trade?
Review of SEZs
734. SHRI A. VIJAYARAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Special Economic Zone
(SEZ) Act envisages many Special
Economic Zones in the country;
(b) it so, the details of such Zones, State-
wise, as on date;
(c) whether there is any proposal to
review the processing and non-processing
area, protection of workers' rights,
regulation of land use within the area tax
and other concessions and total number of
SEZs, irrespective of its class and size;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Review of wheat import policy
735. SHRI RAMDAS AGARWAL:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the country is facing
shortage in supply of wheat at present and
is importing the same;
(b) if so, what quantity and at what
price, per quintal, of wheat was imported
during the last three years, year-wise;
(c) whether Government restored
customs duty cut on wheat imports, which
was brought down to five per cent in
August, 2006; and
(d) whether Government propose to
review the wheat import policy in the near
future; if so, the details thereof?
Industrially backward areas in Andhra
Pradesh
736. SHRI C. RAMA-
CHANDRAIAH: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Ministry has identified
any industrial backward areas in Andhra
Pradesh;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) what special schemes are being
implemented by Government for providing
fiscal concessions to improve the industrial
infrastructure and to create conducive

172
climate for setting up of industries and flow
